name: Lorraine Carol Flatt

events.place: Elmwood Mennonite Brethren Church, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes: Lorraine and her aunt Elsie (nee Flatt) Neufeld produced a book on descendants of Michael Flatt.  He was born on February 25, 1947 and died January 19, 1947. His wife was Maria Schmidt Flatt  born March 14, 1864 and died September 20, 1940.
